title: GibiWorld Intent Envelope
description: GW-ARCH-002 section 7. The contract for ANY priority-3 intent source. GW-ARCH-002 step 6 selected architecture B: no language model ships, and the local deterministic policy is priority 4/5, not 3. This envelope therefore has no producer today and exists so a future remote or local source can slot in without redesign. additionalProperties:false keeps GW-AI-002 structural: a source cannot name an animation, coordinate, force, price, score, or moderation result because there is nowhere to put one.

catalogRevision.description: MUST match the catalog the client compiled against. A mismatch is rejected rather than reconciled: a source tuned against a different intent set will fight the arbiter.

intent.description: Mirrors contracts/schemas/intent-catalog.json. IntentCatalogParityTests asserts this enum and the C# catalog agree exactly.

targetId.description: SHALL be present in the submitted context. A source cannot name an object that was not offered to it.

modifiers.description: How the action is performed. This is where felt life comes from; the client clamps every value against the catalog cap for the chosen intent and against the active care profile, so an out-of-range request is narrowed, never honoured.

utteranceKey.description: A localization key, never prose. No token produced by any source reaches a player as text.
